name: Breaking the Keystone
summary: The voice has more freedom now, though the Keystone still binds it. The Keystone lies among a ring of stones, and Fozruk holds the key the watchers call the Rod of Order.

sections.title: The Last Lock
sections.body: Opening the Stones of Binding eased the voice's confinement, but one lock still holds the Keystone. It lies among the circle of stones around you. Fozruk, a stone watcher and one of its captors, holds the key the watchers call the Rod of Order. Carry the rod to the Keystone and open the lock. The voice promises gratitude that will shake the earth to its roots. Geomantic energy fills the Keystone.

sections.title: At the Keystone
sections.body: When you set the rod into the Keystone, a tremor runs beneath you.

faq.answer: The Stones of Binding came first. Opening them eased much of the voice's confinement.
Fozruk is a stone watcher and one of the voice's captors. He holds the key to the Keystone.

faq.q: What is the Rod of Order?
faq.answer: The stone watchers call the key to the Keystone the Rod of Order. Fozruk holds it.
The Keystone lies among a circle of stones in the Arathi Highlands.

attribution: Classic quest text: Breaking the Keystone
